$comment: Dependency advisories deliberately not fixed yet, each with a review date.
The verification command blocks on any high or critical advisory in a shipped
dependency. An entry under `advisories` (keyed by package name, read by
scripts/audit-dependencies.mjs) suppresses one — but only until its `expires` date,
after which the gate fails on the exception itself. That is the point: a deferral
becomes a decision with a review date rather than a permanent hole nobody revisits.
Add an entry only when the advisory is genuinely unreachable from how this project
uses the package, and say why in `reason` — 'not exploitable here' is not a
reason, it is a claim. Name the code path.
release, and every package below reaches it only as a build or test tool. npm audit no
longer marks devDependencies, and apps/web lists vite and its plugins under
`dependencies`, so the gate counts them as shipped. What ships is the static bundle in
apps/web/dist and the agent; `npm ls --omit=dev -w apps/agent` holds none of them.

picomatch.reason: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf, no fixed version exists. Reached only through vite, vitest, tinyglobby, unplugin and the eslint parser, at build and test time, matching globs this repository writes itself; nothing evaluates a user-supplied glob.

fdir.reason: Flagged only for its picomatch dependency; used by tinyglobby inside vite and vitest at build and test time.

tinyglobby.reason: Flagged only for picomatch and fdir; globbing inside vite, vitest and the eslint parser over this repository's own files.

unplugin.reason: Flagged only for picomatch; runs inside @react-aria/optimize-locales-plugin during the web build.

@react-aria/optimize-locales-plugin.reason: Vite build plugin (apps/web/vite.config.ts); flagged only through unplugin -> picomatch. Not present in the built bundle.

vite.reason: Build tool for apps/web and soty-review, flagged only through picomatch, fdir and tinyglobby. Users receive the static output in apps/web/dist; no vite dev server is exposed beyond the developer's machine.

@vitejs/plugin-react.reason: Vite build plugin, flagged only through vite.

@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree.reason: ESLint parser run by `npm run lint` over this repository's sources; flagged through minimatch and tinyglobby glob matching of its own project globs.

vitest.reason: Test runner only (scripts/run-unit-suite.mjs, `vitest run`). GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 is a path traversal through @vitest/mocker's redirect in a served browser or UI session; this repository runs vitest headless from the CLI and never serves it. The fix is vitest 4.1.11, a major upgrade scheduled before the expiry.
